entries.title: DD point 3: signup lives in the separate boe_landing repo (Next.js); redirect to app.beonedge.in is a landing change
entries.text: STATIC. /home/nethunter07/PROJECTS/boe_landing (its own tally repo) holds the beonedge.in site. src/components/SignupForm.tsx posts to its /api/newuser route (src/app/api/newuser/route.ts -> src/lib/newuser.ts), which forwards to the app API (BEO_API_BASE, allowed hosts dev-app.beonedge.in / app.beonedge.in in src/lib/env.ts:18). On success it shows an in-page message (SignupForm.tsx:134-140) saying approval email includes the app download link; no redirect and no app.beonedge.in web link. Point 3 therefore needs either a landing change (redirect/link the signup CTA to app.beonedge.in) or a web signup surface in boe_app; boe_app has to provide the target page either way.
